faq.q: What is Tulip M-100 donked-out car in GTA 6?

Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Tulip M-100 donked-out car confirmed for GTA 6?
